signals_info.description: Time headway to the selected lead vehicle.

nl_Literal_translation_en: At some time between 2 and 5 seconds from now, the time headway to the lead vehicle shall be greater than 2 seconds.
nl_Literal_translation_zh: 从现在起第 2 秒到第 5 秒之间，与前车的时间车头时距应至少有一个时刻大于 2 秒。
nl_Paraphrase_en: During the window from the second through the fifth second, the time headway to the lead vehicle shall exceed 2 seconds at least once.
nl_Paraphrase_zh: 在第 2 秒至第 5 秒的窗口内，与前车的时间车头时距应至少有一个时刻大于 2 秒。
